culprit_citations.quoted_text: Select Rehabilitation, LLC - Term Loan B (12) | Health Care Equipment & Services | Fixed 7.50 % PIK | 7.50 % | 12/29/2028 | 13,440 | 6,088 | 3,091 | 0.6 | %

findings.detail: The fixed-rate label was misparsed as basis_spread 7.0; basis_spread should be null and the stated fixed PIK interest rate is 7.50%.
Two current-period extracted rows are flagged for one current-period source position, indicating a duplicate extraction of Select Rehabilitation Term Loan B.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full raw-source row shows that 7.50% is explicitly labeled Fixed PIK and is repeated as the interest rate; it is not a floating spread. Therefore the stored basis_spread value 7.0 on both flagged rows is a real extraction error. The raw current-period schedule contains one such position while the artifact reports two flagged row keys, supporting a second duplicate-extraction finding. No aggregate anchor is applicable to this row-level rate-field defect.
